meta.title: JoVee — everything you and your band need
meta.desc: Amps, pedals, TONE3000, stems, tab, drums, looper and tuner in one app for guitar, bass and vocals. macOS, Windows and Linux.
hero.h1: Everything you and your band need.
hero.alt: JoVee Rig with one chain per instrument
dl.sub: Every installer of the latest JoVee Rig version.
fam.sub: Each app does one thing. Rig is available now; the others are coming soon.
fam.studio: Record, edit, mix and finish songs across multiple tracks, with Rig inside.
fam.tone: Recreates a recording's tone by measuring it and sets it up on Rig.
fam.lut: Guides your guitar setup step by step, measuring each string by its sound.
fam.live: Play live over the internet with other musicians, each on their own rig and with their own monitor mix.
fam.school: An electric guitar course from zero to advanced in rock, blues and metal, that listens to you play to measure your progress.
cta.h2: Download JoVee Rig and plug in your guitar.
portal.sub: From the first chord to rehearsal, one app for every moment of playing.
step.school.h: Start from zero and see how far you have come.
step.rig.h: Amps, cabs and pedals on your computer.
step.tone.h: The recording's tone, on your rig.
step.studio.h: Record the whole song at home.
step.live.h: Rehearse with your band, each at home.
ap.jam.lede: Add a song, split the band into tracks and play along with the tab and the lyrics scrolling.
ap.jam.how.h2: Add the song and play with its band.
ap.jam.s1.p: Search for it inside the app or bring it from your computer.
ap.jam.s2.p: Drums, bass, vocals, guitar, piano and the rest, each on its own track.
ap.jam.s3.p: Level, pan, mute and solo per track: take the guitar out and play in its place.
ap.jam.s4.p: Jam listens to you and marks each note on time, late, wrong or missed.
ap.jam.f.h2: Everything you need to play a whole song.
ap.jam.f1.p: Imported, or generated from the separated guitar, and refretted for your tuning.
ap.jam.f2.p: Lyrics with chords, the line being sung lit up.
ap.jam.f3.p: Your Rig tone changes by itself at the points of the song you mark.
ap.jam.f4.p: A count-in before you come in and each section’s name spoken on time.
ap.jam.f5.p: Fix notes, chords and lyric lines by hand.
ap.jam.f6.p: Filter your songs by artist and by the tracks already split.
ap.tone.lede: Pick a song: Tone measures the guitar tone on the recording and builds it in your Rig.
ap.tone.how.h2: From the record to your rig, measuring note by note.
ap.tone.s1.p: Search for it and bring in the recording’s audio.
ap.tone.s2.p: Tone looks up the gear used on the record, with a source for each piece.
ap.tone.s3.p: Each guitar note on the record is compared with the same note played on your guitar.
ap.tone.s4.p: The result becomes a ready preset in JoVee Rig.
ap.tone.f.h2: What Tone uses to reach the record’s tone.
ap.tone.f1.p: Splits the guitar from the song to find where it plays and which note it is.
ap.tone.f2.p: Measures chords as well as single notes, low string included.
ap.tone.f3.p: Half a step down, a whole step down and drop D down to B.
ap.tone.f4.p: Record each note of your guitar once; Tone compares against it.
ap.tone.f5.p: Pick which guitar of the song to measure.
ap.tone.f6.p: Limit the measurement to the minutes you choose.
ap.lut.lede: It says what to play, listens to your guitar and tells you which screw to turn, and which way.
ap.lut.how.h2: A setup step by step, listening to each string.
ap.lut.s1.p: The app says which string or note to play.
ap.lut.s2.p: It measures by sound what is out of place.
ap.lut.s3.p: Plain words plus a drawing of the part, the tool and the turn.
ap.lut.s4.p: It listens again until it is right, and shows the before and after.
ap.lut.f.h2: A full setup, in the right order.
ap.lut.f1.p: Fresh strings tuned to pitch before anything else.
ap.lut.f2.p: Measured with a ruler or feeler gauge, with a drawing of where to measure.
ap.lut.f3.p: How much to raise or lower each bridge saddle.
ap.lut.f4.p: Which side and how far to turn each pickup screw.
ap.lut.f5.p: Where to move each saddle so fret 12 matches the open string.
ap.lut.f6.p: At the end, a PDF with what each stage found and how it was left.
ap.studio.lede: Record, edit, mix and finish songs on many tracks, with JoVee Rig on every track.
ap.studio.how.h2: From the first take to the finished song.
ap.studio.s1.p: Arm many tracks and record from any input, hearing yourself through the Rig.
ap.studio.s2.p: Cut, move, trim and fade clips; the original file is never changed.
ap.studio.s3.p: Faders, pan, sends, buses and groups, with automation on any control.
ap.studio.s4.p: The mix and each track apart, as WAV, FLAC or MP3.
ap.studio.f.h2: A complete studio, with your rig inside.
ap.studio.g1.i1: Its own chain on every track, with the Rig's blocks
ap.studio.g1.i3: Arm, mute, solo, fader and pan
ap.studio.g1.i4: Monitor without arming, freeze to save CPU
ap.studio.g1.i5: A clean DI in every take, for re-amping
ap.studio.g1.i6: Punch-in, loop recording and take comping
ap.studio.g1.i7: A count-in of 1 to 4 bars, and a click
ap.studio.g1.i8: Stems from JoVee Stem become tracks
ap.studio.g2.i1: Move, trim, split, copy, paste and duplicate
ap.studio.g2.i3: Stretch in time without changing the pitch
ap.studio.g2.i4: Snap to grid, from whole to sixteenth notes
ap.studio.g3.i1: Type the tempo or tap it
ap.studio.g3.i3: Sections that move everything inside them
ap.studio.g3.i5: Imports Guitar Pro with the tab
ap.studio.g3.i6: The same markers as JoVee Jam
ap.studio.g4.i3: JoVee drum kit or an LV2/VST3 plugin
ap.studio.g5.i1: A live meter on every channel
ap.studio.g5.i3: Aux buses, sends pre or post fader
ap.studio.g5.i4: Folder tracks, VCA faders and groups
ap.studio.g5.i5: Automation of volume, pan and any knob
ap.studio.g5.i7: Its own output for each track
ap.studio.g5.i8: Render a track in place or to a new one
ap.studio.g5.i9: A color per track, drag to reorder
ap.studio.g6.i1: Save as takes the audio along
ap.studio.g6.i3: Mix as WAV, FLAC or MP3
ap.studio.g6.i6: Each track as a separate WAV
ap.studio.g7.i3: MIDI learn for transport, faders and knobs
ap.studio.g7.i4: MCP and gRPC: all the screen does, from outside
ap.live.lede: Rehearse with your band or take a lesson with your teacher over the internet: each one plays through their own rig and hears everyone in their own monitor mix.
ap.live.how.h2: Band rehearsal with each one at home.
ap.live.s1.p: Each musician plays through their own Rig.
ap.live.s2.p: Two to six musicians, connected straight to each other, by invite code or link.
ap.live.s3.p: Set each musician’s level in your own headphones.
ap.live.s4.p: In the same city, the estimated delay is 8 to 15 ms over a wired connection.
ap.live.f.h2: Everything a rehearsal and a lesson need, in one room.
ap.school.lede: Follow the method of a music school using the courses you already bought, or live classes with your teacher.
ap.school.how.h2: You pick the method, your courses fill it, the app listens.
ap.school.s1.t: Say what you want to play
ap.school.s1.p: Play with friends, solo, metal, write and record, or go all the way: the goal decides which subjects come in.
ap.school.s2.p: Rockschool, Musicians Institute, Berklee or the JoVee School path: the method decides the order and the levels.
ap.school.s3.p: Each step opens the lesson that teaches it in a course you already bought, or a class with your teacher.
ap.school.s4.p: Right notes, timing and consistency decide when you pass, with a retest the next day.
ap.school.f.h2: The method of a music school, with the courses you already have.
ap.school.g1.i1: Rockschool (RSL): grade by grade, in the order of its electric guitar exams
ap.school.g1.i2: Musicians Institute: term by term, in the order of its guitar program in Hollywood
ap.school.g1.i3: Berklee Online: in the order of its guitar courses, from beginner to metal
ap.school.g1.i4: The JoVee School path: the only one that also teaches tone, drop D, gallop and songwriting
ap.school.g1.i5: Every requirement on screen cites the syllabus it came from
ap.school.g1.i6: Switch method at any time: your progress stays, because it is marked on the subject
ap.school.g2.i1: JoVee School does not sell lessons: it sends you to the right lesson of the course you already have
ap.school.g2.i2: Each step lists the lessons from your courses that teach it, in your teacher's order
ap.school.g2.i3: The lesson plays inside the app, showing only the video
ap.school.g2.i4: See how many steps of the method each course covers, and which steps no course teaches
ap.school.g2.i5: A step that none of your courses teaches gets a public video
ap.school.g3.t: The map of what you learn
ap.school.g3.i1: Each subject is a dot; a line means one subject opens the next
ap.school.g3.i2: At some points the path splits and you choose: blues, metal or songwriting
ap.school.g3.i3: Subjects outside your goal stay on the map, greyed out, and you can add them
ap.school.g3.i4: Say how much time you have per day and the schedule follows
ap.school.g4.i1: The class happens inside the app, with JoVee Live: each one on their own rig
ap.school.g4.i2: The teacher sends the exercise, the backing track and their tone to the student
ap.school.g4.i3: The app measures the student and the result goes back to the teacher
ap.school.g4.i4: Tab, backing tracks and recorded classes stay in one place, to go over again
ap.school.g5.t: The app listens to decide when you move on
ap.school.g5.i1: Right notes, timing, noise, tuning and dynamics, measured from your audio
ap.school.g5.i2: You pass with 4 good takes out of 5, and a retest at least 24 hours later
ap.school.g5.i3: A take that missed comes back with what to fix
ap.school.g5.i4: Each lesson has tab with the fingering, notation, a diagram and audio
fam.rig: Build each instrument's rig with amps, cabs and pedals, in any order you want.
fam.jam: Add a song and play along with the band, the tab and the lyrics.
ap.live.g1.i1: Create a room and invite by code or link
ap.live.g1.i2: Join with your name, instrument and chain
ap.live.g1.i6: Hand the room over or end it
ap.live.g2.i1: Goes out already processed: nobody needs your plugins
ap.live.g2.i2: Pick the chain you send and your talk mic
ap.live.g2.i4: The network never gets in your rig’s way
ap.live.g2.i5: 8 to 15 ms in the same city, wired
ap.live.g2.i6: Each member’s delay on screen, direct or relay
ap.live.g3.i1: A channel per member: fader, meter, solo, mute
ap.live.g3.i2: Each member on the output you choose
ap.live.g3.i3: Your mix doesn’t change anyone else’s
ap.live.g3.i4: Talk mic with its own fader
ap.live.g3.i6: Weak internet: the video drops, the audio stays
ap.live.g4.i1: The click lands at the same moment for everyone
ap.live.g4.i2: Song, backing tracks, drums and metronome in sync
ap.live.g4.i3: Each one plays their own copy, full quality
ap.live.g4.i4: A missing song is sent by the room
ap.live.g4.i5: The owner runs play, tempo and recording, and can hand it over
ap.live.g4.i6: Rig, Studio and Jam join the room
ap.live.g5.i1: Each one records on their own machine
ap.live.g6.i1: Teacher and student on the same song
ap.live.g6.i2: The teacher sends the exercise, backing track and tone
ap.live.g6.i3: The app measures the student for the teacher
ap.live.g6.i5: Tab and backing tracks in the lesson
ap.rig.f.h2: Each instrument with its own rig.
